summary: Internal links should use :ref: with anchors, every page needs at least one anchor, long pages can have local TOCs, and raw URLs should be avoided in favor of titled links for screen readers.
questions: Should I paste raw URLs in Ansible docs?
How do internal links work in the Ansible docs?

answer_card.title: Internal navigation rules
answer_card.answer_md:
- Use `:ref:` for all internal links; every page needs at least one anchor.
- Long or deep pages can add a local TOC.
- Avoid raw URLs (bad for screen readers). For external links use `` `link title <link-url>`_ ``.
